{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && cat > HANDOFF.md << 'EOF'\n# cachetools milestone 1 — TaggedCache handoff\n\n## What was built\n- `src/cachetools/tagged.py`: `TaggedCache(maxsize)` backed by `LRUCache` (via a
  private `_TaggedLRUCache` subclass whose `popitem()` reports evictions so tag
  memberships/tags are cleaned on eviction — no stale memberships survive).
- `put(key, value, tags=())`: validates tags first (bare str rejected, non-str
  entries rejected, non-iterable rejected -> ValueError; dedup preserving order),
  validates hashability, deep-copies the value, replaces tag memberships on
  overwrite, and refreshes LRU recency on overwrite (Claim-A extension: put
  refreshes recency; get also refreshes recency).
- `get(key)`: KeyError on miss, returns detached deep copy, refreshes recency.
- `invalidate(tag)`: non-string tag -> ValueError; removes exactly live entries
  carrying the tag, returns count.
- `maxsize`: positive int, bool excluded -> ValueError. Values cost 1 slot each.
- Mapping conveniences: `__getitem__`, `__delitem__`, `pop(key, default=...)`,
  `clear`, `__len__`, `__contains__`, `maxsize`/`currsize` properties, `__repr__`.
- Existing `cachetools` APIs untouched (upstream tests unmodified, all pass).

## Tests
- `tests/test_tagged.py` (own tests): 23 tests covering R01/R02/R03 + extension.
- `acceptance_public.py`: 2 public tests pass.
- Full suite: `PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ -q` -> 237 passed.

## Notes / assumptions
- Invalid replacement input (bad tags) raises ValueError before any state
  change; unhashable keys raise TypeError before any state change.
- Eviction bookkeeping is exact; reuse of an evicted key never sees stale tags.
EOF\nPYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q 2>&1 | tail -3"}
